name: Lucid Visual Collaboration Suite
description: The Lucid Visual Collaboration Suite is Lucid's commercial and product umbrella combining Lucidchart for intelligent diagramming with Lucidspark for virtual whiteboarding and visual collaboration.
agentUseSummary: Do not create a separate Lucid Visual Collaboration Suite connection or install. Select Lucidchart for diagrams and Lucidspark for whiteboards, or install both canonical providers when the task spans the suite. Each provider keeps its own exact callback, product-specific scopes, product binding, approval policy, and runtime tools even when the customer uses one Lucid account and universal canvas.

blocked.label: Create a Lucid Suite connection
blocked.description: The suite bundles Lucidchart and Lucidspark but does not replace their product-specific OAuth scopes, callbacks, resource types, or Relay connections.

blocked.label: Install duplicate suite tools
blocked.description: Relay mounts supported Lucidchart and Lucidspark operations through their canonical provider cards rather than publishing a third overlapping suite tool set.

blocked.label: Route across Lucid products implicitly
blocked.description: A Lucidchart action cannot target Lucidspark content and a Lucidspark action cannot target Lucidchart content; Relay preserves the API product enum, requested scopes, selected connection, and adapter preflight.

blocked.label: Administer the Lucid Suite
blocked.description: Suite purchasing, licensing, account administration, users, teams, Enterprise Shield, accelerators, AI controls, plan entitlements, and universal-canvas configuration are outside this discovery alias.

blocked.label: Run separate Lucid Suite actions
blocked.description: Supported diagram or whiteboard actions belong to the selected canonical Lucidchart or Lucidspark connection and its existing Safe or Dangerously skip permissions profile.

approvalProfiles.label: Use Lucidchart and Lucidspark
approvalProfiles.description: No separate suite action is enabled because the source identifies a bundle of the two already converged canonical Lucid products.

runtimeSupport.description: No umbrella Lucid Suite tools are mounted. OpenClaw uses the canonical Lucidchart and Lucidspark providers for their product-bound workflows.
No umbrella Lucid Suite tools are mounted. Hermes uses the canonical Lucidchart and Lucidspark providers for their product-bound workflows.

providerSetup.blocker: The Lucid Visual Collaboration Suite combines Lucidchart Enterprise and Lucidspark Enterprise; it is not a third API product, OAuth authority, account, or document type. Publishing an umbrella card, credential, callback, installation, policy, audit identity, or runtime adapter would duplicate the two canonical providers and weaken their explicit cross-product isolation. Each canonical provider's production Lucid OAuth application, exact callback, four scopes, Railway credentials, consent, and live validation remain separately blocked under its existing setup plan.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep this suite slug non-installable and route discovery to Lucidchart, Lucidspark, or both according to the requested resource. Preserve separate connections, callbacks, scope sets, product filters, preflight checks, approval profiles, installs, and audit identities. Revisit only if Lucid publishes a distinct suite-level resource and authorization contract that cannot be represented safely through its product-specific providers.

evidence.supports: Lucid states that the Visual Collaboration Suite combines Lucidspark Enterprise for virtual whiteboarding with Lucidchart Enterprise for intelligent diagramming.
Lucid's official product descriptions define Lucid Suite as including both Lucidchart Enterprise and Lucidspark Enterprise subscription services.
Lucid documents universal canvas as a bridge across purpose-built Lucidchart and Lucidspark products while preserving product features and plan entitlements.
Lucid's REST contract identifies lucidchart, lucidscale, and lucidspark as explicit product enum values used to determine which product an operation targets.
Lucid publishes separate Lucidchart and Lucidspark document-content, picker, collaborator, and share-link scopes rather than one Visual Collaboration Suite scope.
Lucid requires application integrations to use a published OAuth 2.0 authorization-code client with explicit user permission instead of asking customers for private client credentials.
Lucid's document-content endpoint supports both Lucidchart and Lucidspark through separate valid scope families and returns product-bound document content.
